{{Top|leg}}
A '''honeydarter''' was a type of floating creature that partially shared its name with [[Honey/Legends|honey]].<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] compared a group of [[Geroon (species)|Geroons]]&mdash;who were, unbeknownst to [[Gender/Legends|him]], [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] posing as members of the other [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;talking about the [[Cruiser/Legends|Chiss diplomatic vessel]] ''[[Chaf Envoy]]''{{'s}} stop at [[Brask Oto Command Station]] near [[The Redoubt/Legends|the Redoubt]] [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] to the buzzing of several honeydarters hovering over a "promising" [[Flower/Legends|flower bush]].<ref name="SQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Honeydarters were mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="SQ" />
